review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–84). It defines actualKernelCoefficient and actualKernelSourceTerm, plus a positivity lemma, an argument-rewrite lemma, and a numeric unfolding lemma. All of these are specific to this project's kernel and cusp setup. They use Mathlib's Ideal.absNorm, Real.sqrt, Finset.prod and similar, but they don't re-implement any of those. They are named specialisations of the project's own fixedKernelCoefficient and source_kernel_argument_factor, which are defined elsewhere. I did not look for Mathlib counterparts to the project-specific kernel and coefficient definitions, so I can't rule out an overlap there. Nothing in this file points to an avoidable competing version of an existing Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core concept.
